sources.title: A Message from Co-Founder and CEO Brian Chesky
sources.quote_checked: We are collectively living through the most harrowing crisis of our lifetime | nearly 1,900 teammates will have to leave Airbnb | Map all reductions to our future business strategy and the capabilities we will need.

sources.title: Airbnb CEO eliminated 'fiefdoms' and got more involved to survive the pandemic — 'it worked better anyway'
sources.quote_checked: We shuttered most of the divisions. | There's one road map, and no one ships anything unless it's on the roadmap. | We're not gonna do anything we cannot personally focus on. So if I can't personally focus on it, we won't do it. | I'm not there to micromanage as much as I'm there as an orchestra conductor to make sure it plays one cohesive sound

sources.title: Inside Brian Chesky's 5-step hiring strategy to cut red tape
sources.quote_checked: In the age of AI, my argument is you need to be founder oriented/founder mode | You don't manage people. You manage people through the work. | Hiring is too much like a sales pipeline, and hiring should be more like network building than a sales pipeline | You never want to get the first answer. You always want the third answer

sources.title: How to Scale to 100M Users (Masters of Scale, republished on The Tim Ferriss Show, episode 326)
sources.quote_checked: We basically took one part of our product and we extrapolated what would a five star experience be. Then we went crazy. | You have to almost design the extreme to come backwards. | there's some sweet spot between they showed up and they opened the door and I went to space.

sources.title: Airbnb's IPO: 6 key things to know
Citing revenue declines, Airbnb cuts 1,900 jobs, or around 25% of its global workforce
